project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA, local-first (no backend), Vite 5 build, Tailwind 3, Zustand app state, Zod validation, Recharts, React Router 6. Pure-TS simulation engine is the project's strength and must NOT be touched.
build_system: Vite 5 (npm). Build: `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build` (must exit 0). Lint: `npm run lint` (eslint). Dev: `npm run dev`. Path aliases configured in vite.config.ts + tsconfig.app.json: @/, @simulation, @data, @ai, @game, @store. tsconfig.app.json is strict with noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters/noFallthroughCasesInSwitch/noUncheckedSideEffectImports. No enums (use `as const` string literals). No `any` (use `unknown` + guards). Non-null `!` only in tests with a comment.
test_framework: Vitest 2 (`npm run test -- --run` for single run; `npm run test:watch` for watch). globals:true, environment: jsdom, setupFiles: ./tests/setup.ts (only `import '@testing-library/jest-dom'`). Tests live under tests/unit/* and tests/integration/*. Component tests use @testing-library/react + MemoryRouter; hook tests use renderHook + act. Baseline: 14 files / 91 tests passing.
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm run build` and confirm exit code 0 with zero TS errors. 2) Run `npm run test -- --run` and confirm all tests pass (baseline 91; this task targets 120+). 3) Run `git -C "c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS" diff --name-only` and confirm NO path under src/simulation/ appears (the engine is untouched). 4) Manually reason the flow: Onboarding -> Planet -> Crew -> Config -> Start Mission -> Mission Control (Advance Day, resolve event, ask Astro-AI) -> End Mission -> Debrief. 5) Confirm reduced-motion toggle works, focus-visible rings visible, no color-only signals.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Build produces dist/ (gitignored, not checked in). No generated source files are checked in. package-lock.json updates when deps install.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Node 24, npm 11. Workspace root: c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS (relative paths land in the PARENT workspace, not the worktree, so use absolute paths). jsdom has NO window.matchMedia — guard all matchMedia usage with `typeof window !== 'undefined'`. NEVER edit anything under src/simulation/. NEVER install three/@react-three/* or Phaser-related 3D (3D is a later phase). Pin the only two new deps exactly: framer-motion@11.18.2 and @phosphor-icons/react@2.1.10 (both verified React-18 compatible).
contribution_requirements: Per .kiro/steering/coding-standards: functional components only; typed props via named interface above each component; max ~300 lines/file (split larger); no React/Zustand/Phaser imports in src/simulation/; Result<T,E> pattern for fallible ops; Zod-validate external data; scientific constants need source comments. Per architecture: presentation -> application -> simulation; components must NOT import the simulation engine directly (use useMissionControl); ai -> data (read-only); ai never writes simulation state. Conventional Commits (feat:/fix:/test:/chore:). Commit locally on the branch; never push. Keep files under ~300 lines.
key_patterns: useMissionControl hook (src/hooks/useMissionControl.ts) is the ONLY bridge to the engine; it exposes selectors + actions (initializeMission/advanceDay/resolveEvent/emergencyRation/endMission) and is consumed by all screens. Zustand stores: useMissionStore (mission state + setup choices + snapshot) and useAppStore (UI: isLoading/globalError/astroAIPanelOpen). Screens read state via the hook, never the store directly. MissionDebriefScreen.tsx is the ONLY real screen today — use it as the pattern for screen structure (sub-components, typed props, useNavigate, useMissionControl). Existing test pattern: reset stores in beforeEach with `missionStore.setState({...INITIAL_MISSION_STATE})` and `useAppStore.setState({...})`; render components in `<MemoryRouter>`. EventCard/ResourceBar do not exist yet. AstroAssistant (src/ai/astro-assistant.ts) wraps an OpenAI-compatible API with a graceful knowledge-base fallback; never throws.
